name: com.raventween.core
description: High-performance, allocation-free tweening engine for Unity, in code or in the Inspector. Fluent API, sequences, async/await, coroutines, and no-code tools for designers: 44 ready-made motions with a Motion Library, Raven Motion, Stagger, Button Feel, Show Hide, Feedback, Path, Typewriter and Counter components, Motion Styles, Tween Templates and a visual Sequence Editor.

samples.description: Buttons, panels and canvas group fades driven by RavenTween.
Transform tweens for gameplay feel: jumps, punches, loops.
Camera field of view, shake and color transitions.
Material property tweens using shader property IDs.
Nested sequences with Chain, Group and Insert.
Thousands of live tweens with frame time and GC allocation readout.
Typewriter reveal, number counter and punch feedback on TMP text.
Head look-at and antenna spring chain blended with weight tweens.
Rigidbody tweens in FixedUpdate, Incremental and PingPong cycles, timeline callbacks, property blocks and a hit stop.
Raven Motion, Stagger, Button Feel, Show Hide, Feedback and Path: a menu, a hit, a popup, a collectible and a moving platform animated without animation code.
